basic_details.short_information: The Delhi Technological University (DTU) Guest Faculty Notification 2026 has been released on 23 July 2026 on the official website of Delhi Technological University (DTU). The university has invited eligible candidates to participate in the DTU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 through a walk-in interview for contractual Guest Faculty positions.

qualification.details: B.E./ B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. and Ph.D. in relevant branch with 1st class or equivalent either in B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. from a recognized University OR 1st class or equivalent in B.E./B.Tech. in relevant branch and Ph.D. in relevant branch from a recognized University OR M.Sc. in relevant branch with at least 55% marks and must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET. Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Ph.D. regulations 2009 may be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET.

content_sections.heading: DTU Guest Faculty Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DTU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DTU Guest Faculty Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.E./ B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. and Ph.D. in relevant branch with 1st class or equivalent either in B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. from a recognized University OR 1st class or equivalent in B.E./B.Tech. in relevant branch and Ph.D. in relevant branch from a recognized University OR M.Sc. in relevant branch with at least 55% marks and must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET. Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Ph.D. regulations 2009 may be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET.

content_sections.text: Rs. 1750/- per hour (Theory) / Rs. 875/- per hour (Lab) with max ceiling Rs. 52,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the Google Form for DTU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the Google Form for the DTU Guest Faculty recruitment is 29th July 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their submission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled for the Guest Faculty positions at DTU?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Guest Faculty positions at Delhi Technological University is scheduled to be held on 31st July 2026. Ensure you are present at the venue on time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications include a B.E./B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. with Ph.D. or an M.Sc. with NET/SLET/SET, along with specific first-class requirements in undergraduate and postgraduate degrees as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the DTU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this DTU Guest Faculty recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty position at DTU?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty position is Rs. 1750/- per hour for theory classes and Rs. 875/- per hour for lab sessions, with a maximum monthly ceiling of Rs. 52,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age limit for applying to the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, there are 0 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty post at Delhi Technological University for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty role at DTU?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.
